scenarios.expected: Clean packaged installation starts without a development server and opens an encrypted synthetic database.
Verified encrypted backup restores to a separate Hub directory with matching migration, counts, and vault hashes.
Both Android device classes install the approved APK and complete Admin-approved enrollment.
SQLCipher Room opens and migrations 1 through 6 preserve synthetic data after process death.
All six approved synchronization scopes negotiate, verify, and apply the minimum-necessary payload.
Wrong trust anchors and permanent security failures fail closed; transient outage recovers with retry-now and safe sync health.
Authorized Android view/upload works through the Hub vault; unauthorized roles are denied; Android persistence inventory is clean.
FLAG_SECURE and viewer cleanup behavior are observed for screenshots, recents, recording, rotation, and process death.
Android receives and validates a minimized EGP billing summary without enabling Android billing writes.
Signed APK installation, upgrade, rollback, checksum/signature verification, and device revocation/re-enrollment pass.
